hub.title: Study Hub
hub.subtitle: Turn your knowledge base into an active learning experience. Pick a mode to get started.

quiz.label: Quiz Mode
quiz.desc: Test your recall with auto-generated quizzes at three difficulty levels.

workshop.label: Workshop Creator
workshop.desc: Multi-lesson workshops built from your knowledge base, lesson-by-lesson.

flashcards.label: Flashcards
flashcards.desc: Scrollable flip-cards generated from your documents.

mindmaps.label: Mindmaps
mindmaps.desc: Visual concept maps with PDF, PNG and Markdown export.

config.title: Set up your quiz
config.subtitle: Choose what to study, how challenging it should be, and how many questions you want.
config.scopeHintHas: Quizzes are most accurate when scoped to a single category or a few related files.
config.scopeHintEmpty: Pick at least one category or file. Whole-KB quizzes give scattered, lower-quality results.
config.modeHintExam: Exam — answers stay hidden until you submit. Jump between questions, change answers, and flag ones to revisit.
config.modeHintPractice: Practice — see whether each answer is right the moment you submit it, with the explanation.
config.timeHint: Optional — race the clock. The quiz auto-submits when time runs out.
config.typesHint: Pick at least one question type.

list.emptyBody: Quizzes turn your scoped documents into multiple-choice and true/false questions with instant feedback — and every quiz is saved here so you can retake it anytime.
list.emptyHint: Click ‘New Quiz’ above to get started.

gen.title: Generating your quiz
gen.body: Gemma is reading your selected documents and writing questions just for you. This usually takes 10–40 seconds.

export.title: Export this quiz
export.subtitle: Pick what to include, then choose a format.
export.markdownTip: Download as Markdown (.md) — opens a Save As dialog where you can rename and choose a folder
export.markdownAria: Download as Markdown — opens a Save As dialog

config.title: New Flashcard Deck
config.subtitle: Pick your scope, difficulty, and how many cards to generate.
config.scopeHintHas: Cards are drawn from these documents.
config.scopeHintEmpty: Pick at least one category or file. Wide scope = unfocused cards.

list.emptyBody: Flashcards turn your scoped documents into a deck of flip cards you can review whenever you want a quick recall workout.
list.emptyHint: Click ‘New Deck’ above to get started.
list.deleteMessage: “{{title}}” and all {{count}} of its cards will be permanently removed.

gen.title: Building your deck
gen.body: Gemma is reading your selected documents and writing flip cards. This usually takes 10–40 seconds.
gen.stage1: Picking the key concepts to memorise…
gen.stage3: Varying card formats for richer review…

list.emptyBody: Workshops turn your scoped documents into a structured, multi-lesson learning path you can work through at your own pace.
list.deleteMessage: "{{title}}" and all its lessons will be permanently removed. This can't be undone.

config.title: New Workshop
config.subtitle: Choose your scope, difficulty, and how many lessons to generate.
config.scopeHintHas: The workshop pulls all content from these documents.
config.scopeHintEmpty: Pick at least one category or file. Wide scope = unfocused workshop.

outline.completeBody: Test what you learned with a 5-question recap quiz.
outline.deleteLessonMessage: "{{title}}" and its generated content will be removed from this workshop.

export.markdownTip: Export the whole workshop as Markdown
export.pdfTip: Export the whole workshop as PDF
export.notGenerated: This lesson has not been generated yet.

lesson.errorBody: The model returned incomplete content. This can happen occasionally — try again.
lesson.regenMessage: The current text will be replaced with a freshly generated version. Your completion status is kept.
lesson.regenFailed: Regeneration failed — the previous version was kept.

gen.body: Gemma is writing this from your documents — typically {{eta}}, depending on your hardware.
gen.lessonHint: Upcoming lessons are prepared in the background while you read.
gen.outlineStage3: Drafting lesson titles and reading-time estimates…
gen.lessonStage2: Writing the body, examples, and code blocks…

list.emptyBody: Mindmaps render the central themes and sub-topics of your scoped documents as an interactive radial diagram you can pan, zoom, and export as Markdown, PNG, or PDF.

config.title: New Mindmap
config.subtitle: Pick the documents you want mapped. The mindmap will render the main themes and sub-topics it finds.
config.scopeHintHas: The mindmap will summarise these documents.
config.scopeHintEmpty: Pick at least one category or file. Mindmaps work best when scoped to a single coherent topic.

gen.title: Drawing your mindmap
gen.body: Gemma is reading your documents and structuring the concepts. This usually takes 15–40 seconds.

view.hint: Drag nodes to rearrange · scroll to zoom · drag the background to pan · Shift+drag to multi-select · press F to fit the view · double-click a node to rename
view.resetGraphMessage: "{{title}}" will return to the original AI-generated structure. Your node edits will be lost.

canvas.deleteBranchMessage: "{{label}}" and its {{count}} sub-topics will be removed.
